content: {DRAFT} The DoIP module shall determine the DoIP Activation Line status by the calls to DoIP_ActivationLineSwitch (uint8 InterfaceId, boolean *Active) based on the value of the boolean parameter Active per DoIPInterface with a given InterfaceId . The Activation L ine status is considered “active”, if the boolean value in the call is set to TRUE. The Activation Line status is considered “inactive”, if the boolean value in the call is set to FALSE.
